summary.text: Tahngarth is a Talruum minotaur who served as first mate of the Weatherlight.

bio.text: The Weatherlight crash-landed in the Talruum Mountains, where Tahngarth fought as Sisay's champion, defeated Ghentoth and joined her crew.
After first mate Meida was killed in the Adarkar Wastes, he became Sisay's first mate.
On Rath he was captured by Greven il-Vec and mutated by the Phyrexians under Volrath, then freed before the process completed.
He later confessed he wished he had died on Rath rather than live with the changes Volrath made.
During the Phyrexian Invasion he killed Greven il-Vec and hacked at Yawgmoth's tentacles to buy time for Gerrard, Urza and Karn to complete the Legacy.
Afterward the Dominarians gave Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee a new ship, Victory.

status.text: Tahngarth sails on the Victory with Sisay and Squee after the Legacy was completed, and the latest mention, a 2023 card, shows him relishing bloodying his blades on those who ravaged his home.
